issues.reason: The intransitive-subject test is "does it change?" and a shrinking crowd does: the instruction set's listed classes put every "becomes less X" verb on Patient (weaken / sag / fade, and the change-of-state undergoers collapse / sink / melt / spread), while the Scalar-change route that would license Theme names a distinct figure-bearing verb class (rise / fall / climb / drop / gain / lose / ease / jump / slip) that "shrink" is not part of.

defect_summary: Compliant form: (Patient (sk_shrink $e) (sk_crowd $e)) in place of (Theme (sk_shrink $e) (sk_crowd $e)); the rest of the rule — premises, per-occurrence crowd witness with Member crowd + GroupOf nightmoth, LocatedIn on the crowd, During tie — stands.
notes: The issue's "no figures stated" clause is not itself the operative criterion (the Scalar-change class is defined by the verb, not by whether figures appear), but the verb-class analogy the issue rests on holds. (Patient $e nightmoth) on "hunts nightmoths" is likewise borderline and was not filed, so it is untouched here.
